title: Cursor adapter
description:
Purpose: extract human-authored messages from Cursor on macOS — IDE agent/chat conversations in state.vscdb SQLite (globalStorage plus workspaceStorage) and agent-CLI transcripts under ~/.cursor/projects/<sanitized>/agent-transcripts.

Scope: SQLite reader decision (built-in node:sqlite with an engines bump vs an optional dependency) — highest-risk decision, spike first; discovery that unions the Cursor 2.x per-workspace composer.composerData index and the 3.x+ central composer.composerHeaders index (the 3.0 migration is one-way and the central index is incomplete for old chats); WAL-safe read-only access (never read state.vscdb without its -wal sidecar); project attribution via workspace.json and workspaceIdentifier URIs; extraction of type-1 user bubbles (text field) with injected-context discrimination; agent-transcript JSONL schema captured from a real Mac; subagent composers excluded; dedup by composer/bubble ids; incremental re-scan via createdAt watermarks. Cursor formats are undocumented and reverse-engineered — every claim must be pinned against a real Mac.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass for both 2.x and 3.x fixture databases and for agent transcripts; reads are safe while Cursor is running; huge databases stream (no SELECT * on checkpoint or request-context blobs); doctor reports on a real Mac's roots.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Epic complete locally: both index shapes and agent transcripts pass golden tests, WAL-safe reads verified, doctor implemented. Real-Mac items remain open in KDATAP-e9aa3c (agent transcript schema, index key spellings, subagent id shapes).
